title: Turning an iPhone into a LiDAR, IMU and GPS Sensor
author: Harshit Agarwal

title: A Browser Dashboard for a ROS 2 Sensor Rig
author: Harshit Agarwal
description: Building a Vue dashboard for a ROS 2 sensor rig at SMLab, NISER: rosbridge, compressed camera streams, rosbag recording and playback, a FastAPI backend and a browser terminal.

title: Hands-on Quantum Programming at IISER Bhopal

description: Notes from the QuCIS NPTEL quantum programming workshop at IISER Bhopal: qubits, Bell states, universal gates and Deutsch–Jozsa derived from scratch in PennyLane.

title: A Google Lens Alternative for a Job Interview, Re-Audited
author: Harshit Agarwal
description: Image similarity search five ways (CNN features, ViT, DINOv2, CLIP, LSH, triplet loss), a cosplay lens, and an honest audit of the metrics two years later.

author: Harshit Agarwal
description: How FamCare's CRM team hands out coupons, free minutes and support calls from CleverTap journeys while the backend keeps every rule on money.

title: The Demand We Couldn't Serve
author: Harshit Agarwal
description: How we measured families who saw no free slot and left, by joining app events to a server log of every slot grid shown, and why timing mattered.

title: Honest Slots, Priced Idle Time
